$comment: Pinned Ed25519 keys of the OIDC test issuers that sign the corpus's __VALID_JWT__ and OIDC __JWT_*__ identity proofs (PLACEHOLDERS.md, 'Identity-issuer keys'). They are issuer signing keys, not AIDs, so they live here and not in keypairs.json. An adapter's identity-issuer resolver maps an issuer URL to its key from this file; it MUST NOT copy a key from another implementation's source. Each JWT has header {"alg":"EdDSA","typ":"JWT"} with no kid, so the resolver returns exactly one key for the issuer.

vectors.$comment: The trusted OIDC test issuer. Signs __VALID_JWT__ and every OIDC __JWT_*__ negative. When a fixture states no self_trust_anchors, this is the only issuer the verifier trusts (conformance README, 'Receiver policy inputs').

Signs __VALID_JWT_FROM_UNKNOWN_ISSUER__. Published only so that token can be minted again byte for byte on any runner. A resolver MUST NOT return this key for any issuer, and it MUST NOT appear in any fixture's accepted_trust_anchors or trust_anchors.
